scope: OutcomeB is internally driven waiting if individual incoming terms cancel. It is not autonomous336-region memory, an independently computed approval, an unconditional presence latch, quantum collapse, or one C per source. Prearranged finite trains supply both the stopping and restarting conditions. Full-state information is retained and exactly reversible.
